segment.source: Some matches can get pretty darn messy, especially if beasts are involved.<end>

segment.source: I clean the field after the events.<end>

segment.source: My father also used to be a cleaner, just like me now. Rest in peace, Dad.<end>

segment.source: There is only one rule when disposing of crawler carcasses - have someone else do it. Heh, he!<end>

segment.source: Working with mutilated carcasses, tons of blood and reeks from Hell feels horrible at first, but you get used to it after a while.<end>

segment.source: Carnifex used to be my favorite gladiator, no doubts about it.<end>

segment.source: Ahem, I remember one bloke who was pretending to be dead but got up when we came in. He was the fastest one-legged man I've seen in my life!<end>
